Placemaker.Commercial.plotDepth.Tooltip: How deep the shop plots reach from their street or lane (whole 8 m zone cells).
Placemaker.Commercial.lotSize.Tooltip: How many parking aisles deep the lots are.
Placemaker.Commercial.lotGreen.Tooltip: Planting in the parking lots: none, along the edges, or in medians between the rows.
Placemaker.Commercial.evShare.Tooltip: Share of parking bays with an EV charger.
Placemaker.Commercial.amount.Tooltip: How much of the street frontage becomes shop plots.
Placemaker.Commercial.lot.Tooltip: A small car park on the street, in the middle of the frontage.
Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.NoStreet: No existing street runs along the area: shops need one to face (it became a small park).
Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.NoLot: There was no room for a parking lot.
Placemaker.Commercial.Issue.Fallback: The chosen layout did not fit here, so a simpler one was used.
Placemaker.Recipe.StripMall.Description: A parking lot on the street with a row of shops facing it across a lane.
Placemaker.StripMall.Name: Strip mall
Placemaker.StripMall.style.Tooltip: Classic: lot in front, shops behind. Corner: lot on the corner, shops wrap it. Rear alley: shops on the street, lot behind.
Placemaker.StripMall.frontage.Tooltip: How much of the street the strip mall takes; it stays centred.
Placemaker.Recipe.ShoppingPlaza.Descript: Shops round a central court (square, market, parking or green) with a lane in between.
Placemaker.ShoppingPlaza.Name: Shopping plaza
Placemaker.ShoppingPlaza.court.Tooltip: What fills the court the shops face.
Placemaker.ShoppingPlaza.courtWidth.Tool: Width of the court along the street.
Placemaker.ShoppingPlaza.sideLots.Toolti: Parking lots on the street beside the shops.
Placemaker.Recipe.OutdoorMall.Descriptio: A pedestrian shopping street with shops on both sides, a plaza at its end and parking beside it.
Placemaker.OutdoorMall.Name: Outdoor mall
Placemaker.OutdoorMall.style.Tooltip: Promenade: one pedestrian street. Grand: a wide one. Loop: a pedestrian loop with shops on both sides. Lifestyle centre: the street, plaza and green inside a ring drive, lots outside, paseos through the rows.
Placemaker.OutdoorMall.plazaSize.Tooltip: Size of the plaza at the end of the street (0 = none).
Placemaker.OutdoorMall.spineLength.Toolt: Longest the pedestrian street may run into the area.
Placemaker.OutdoorMall.sideLots.Tooltip: Parking lots on the street beside the shops.
Placemaker.Recipe.ShopsPark.Description: A park woven between shop plots, with a small car park.
Placemaker.ShopsPark.Name: Shops & park
Placemaker.ShopsPark.layout.Tooltip: How the shop plots sit between the park and the street.
Placemaker.ShopsPark.parkStyle.Tooltip: Style of the park between the shops.
Placemaker.Commercial.outerRow.Tooltip: A row of plots facing each street round the site, a whole cell clear of the lanes so the street zones them.
Placemaker.Commercial.outerZone.Tooltip: Zone of the plots facing the streets: high density for big buildings on the main frontage.
Placemaker.Commercial.outerDepth.Tooltip: How deep the plots facing the streets reach (whole 8 m cells).
Placemaker.OutdoorMall.playground.Toolti: A small playground in the green behind the plaza.
Placemaker.Recipe.HighStreet.Description: A market street: two pedestrian lanes with a market, café terrace or garden between them and small shops facing it.
Placemaker.HighStreet.Name: High street
Placemaker.HighStreet.centre.Tooltip: What fills the strip between the two lanes.
Placemaker.HighStreet.lane.Tooltip: Pedestrian streets, or shared alleys cars may use.
Placemaker.HighStreet.centreWidth.Toolti: Width of the market strip between the lanes.
Placemaker.HighStreet.streetLength.Toolt: Longest the high street may run into the area; a street at the back makes it a through street.
Placemaker.HighStreet.grain.Tooltip: Fine: one-cell frontages (many little shops). Coarse: three cells.
Placemaker.HighStreet.sideLots.Tooltip: Parking lots on the main street beside the shops, joined to the high street by paseos.
Placemaker.Recipe.RetailPark.Description: A few big stores round one big shared car park, with pad sites on the streets.
Placemaker.RetailPark.Name: Retail park
Placemaker.RetailPark.style.Tooltip: Horseshoe: stores on three sides of the lot. Twin terraces: two rows facing each other across the lot, the road running through.
Placemaker.RetailPark.unit.Tooltip: How wide each store plot is along the road.
Placemaker.RetailPark.road.Tooltip: The service road round the lot: a small road, or an alley.
Placemaker.RetailPark.pads.Tooltip: Small plots on the streets beside the stores (a café, a drive-through).
Placemaker.Recipe.MallPark.Description: A park in the middle of the block, ringed by a lane and small shops facing it; bigger shops on the streets outside.
Placemaker.MallPark.Name: Mall park
Placemaker.MallPark.parkStyle.Tooltip: Style of the park in the middle.
Placemaker.MallPark.loop.Tooltip: The lane round the park: an alley, or a pedestrian street (car-free).
Placemaker.Recipe.MallDistrict.Descripti: The whole block as shops: big plots on the streets, a grid of lanes inside lined with small shops, squares and courtyard gardens.
Placemaker.MallDistrict.Name: Mall district
Placemaker.MallDistrict.lanes.Tooltip: Mixed: alleys from the street, pedestrian lanes across. Alleys: cars everywhere. Pedestrian: car-free.
Placemaker.MallDistrict.blocks.Tooltip: How far apart the lanes are: compact blocks are all shops, spacious ones keep a courtyard garden in the middle.
Placemaker.MallDistrict.squares.Tooltip: Small squares at the central crossing of the lanes.
